text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday♪ And with that, Cesario! 
You're invited to a special party!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, thank you so much!\nWhen did you 
even have the time to prepare this?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's a surprise. Knowing 
Cesario-san, she would have insisted on 
helping with the preparations.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Right! It was so hard keeping it a 
secret, you know? There are practically 
countless participants, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ehhh!? You collected that many for me!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah♪ Everyone's totally up for it, 
saying they want to pay you back for 
always being so kind!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
So for today, please don't fret over 
anything. Just take it easy and relax.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll take you up on that 
offer! I'm gonna go chat with lots of 
girls♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Since we're doing this, I'd really love to 
hear about the troubles that are usually 
hard to talk about.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Taking everyone's words to heart, telling 
me not to shoulder it all alone...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah, I just couldn't help it... Ehehe♪
